meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你搜索开放的技能库，核对技能的热度与来源，给出推荐和安装命令，也能直接替你安装。
howto.when: 当用户问“怎么做X”、找某项技能，或想要扩展能力，且这类功能可能以可安装技能形式存在时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个提升 React 性能的技能
say.note: 我会运行 npx skills find 搜索相关技能。

say.text: 有没有处理 PDF 文档的技能？
say.note: 我会先查排行榜，再核对来源和安装量。

say.text: 找到 changelog 技能就帮我装上
say.note: 我会验证后直接替你执行安装命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will search the public skills ecosystem, check install counts and source reputation, present recommendations with install commands, and can install skills for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks 'how do I do X', asks to find a skill, or wants to extend capabilities—whenever the need might be met by an installable skill.

say_en.text: Find me a skill to optimize React performance
say_en.note: I'll run npx skills find for relevant skills.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for processing PDF documents?
say_en.note: I'll check the leaderboard and verify the source.

say_en.text: If you find a changelog skill, install it for me
say_en.note: I'll verify and run the install command.
